systems.system: Data centers at Diamniadio and Orana

SEN.note: Data centres at Diamniadio and Orana are planned under the programme; none is stated in service or for hire.

facts.fact: Le Marche finance reports that the government launched a universal connectivity project on 24 March 2026 aiming to give internet access to over a million Senegalese, notably in uncovered areas, using fibre and satellites.
Le Marche finance reports that the government launched a sovereign cloud on 24 March 2026, aimed at secure hosting of public data, as part of the New Deal technologique.

SEN.note: The once-only principle is mentioned as introduced, but no law, decree or draft on data sharing between public bodies is stated.
The document says nothing about local government offices being connected.
Data centres are only planned; no nationally owned data centre for hire or government hosting is stated in service.
The Start-up Act and its labelling platform are named as aims of the programme, without saying the act is adopted, startups labelled or a fund financing any.
The document names no hub, incubator or technology park in service or under way, only an ambition to be a regional technology hub.
